name: Agent Builder
description: Create, configure, and improve agents in your organization through conversation.
examples: Build me an agent that triages incoming support emails
Create a research assistant that can search the web and write reports
Update my sales agent to use a smarter model and add the Slack plugin
long_description: Agent Builder lets an agent help you design and manage the other agents in your Hivy organization: it interviews you about what you need, writes clear instructions, picks the right model and capabilities, and creates or updates agents on your behalf. It is installed automatically for every agent in every organization.
